notes.title: v1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
- [Scientist] Added a way to earn gathering and combat experience from science products.
- [Manufacturer] Added 2 new recipes: Gathering Knowledge and Combat Knowledge.
- [Invasions] Added leaderboard rank based on highest invasion score.
- [Taskmaster] Added a new perk to automatically claim tasks.
- [UI] Added an item tracker for the Scientist and Taskmaster.

[b]Changes[/b]
- [Manufacturer] Reduced Depleted Uranium, Astral Alloy and Prismatic Core ingredient requirements.
- [Achievements] Reduced Jackpot requirement from 420 to 42 for "Stonks".
- [Save] Reduced manual cloud save cooldown. The button fill now correctly represents this cooldown.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- [Performance] Fixed performance issues from invasions.
- [Offline] Fixed a time calculation issue that prevented some bounties and expeditions to progress offline.
- [Combat] Removing corruption won't trigger its damage effect anymore.
- [Combat] Drones won't shoot after they are destroyed anymore.
- [Misc] Various typo fixes.

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- [Combat] Fixed a memory issue causing combat to drop performances after a while.
